stem:
Priya wants to see a candle flame through three holes punched in three cardboard sheets in her classroom.
In which arrangement will she be able to see the flame?

options.text: the three holes are in a straight line and Priya's eye is in line with the holes
the three holes are in a straight line but Priya's eye is above the line of the holes
the middle hole is slightly higher than the other two holes
the candle is made brighter so its light can pass through any arrangement of the holes

teacher.key_rationale: Light travels in a straight line, so the flame is seen only when all three holes and the observer's eye lie on one straight line. In B and C the path is bent or misaligned so light does not reach the eye; in D greater brightness does not let light bend around a misaligned path. Hence A.
